# ASEAN Home Service Massage and Spa

> Home, hotel and spa massage in Cebu, Philippines. Licensed, TESDA-certified therapists. Open 12pm to 12am daily.

## Key facts
- Services: Swedish, Thai, deep tissue, sports, pre-natal, hot stone, shiatsu, traditional hilot, foot reflexology, facials, body scrub and more
- Where: at our spa (Unit 2, Wellness Plaza, M. C. Briones St., Cebu City), at your home, or at your hotel
- Areas served: Cebu City, Mandaue, Lapu-Lapu, Talisay and nearby
- Prices: spa massage from PHP 350 per hour; home and hotel rates depend on location
- Booking: home and hotel service needs at least 2 hours notice; travel fee PHP 150 to 300
- Payment: cash, GCash, PayMaya, bank transfer; cards at the spa
- Phone: +63 939 461 3552 | Email: hello@aseanspa.com
